title: SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.37626v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: No single way of parallelizing attention serves large language models well under all loads. Low concurrency favors tensor parallelism, many independent requests favor data-parallel attention, and long prompts favor context parallelism. Reasoning, agentic, and RL-rollout workloads make a fixed choice untenable: a batch that begins as many short requests ends as a few very long ones, so the best layout changes while the same requests run. Serving engines nevertheless fix one layout at launch, because changing it has meant draining requests and restarting workers. We present SPLASH, a serving system that switches the parallel layout of attention while requests are running. It builds on one observation: modern attention, with few or no KV heads, decouples where a request's KV cache lives from how attention weights are sharded. This has two consequences. translated_title: SPLASH：通过无缝交接切换注意力并行布局以实现大语言模型服务
translated_abstract: 没有任何一种单一的注意力并行化方式能够在所有负载下都很好地服务于大语言模型。低并发场景更适合张量并行，大量独立请求更适合数据并行注意力，而长提示词则更适合上下文并行。推理、智能体和强化学习轨迹生成等工作负载使得固定选择变得不可行：一个批次开始时可能是许多短请求，结束时却变成少数非常长的请求，因此最优布局会在相同请求的运行过程中发生变化。然而，现有服务引擎在启动时就固定了一种布局，因为改变布局意味着需要清空请求并重启工作进程。我们提出了SPLASH，一个能够在请求运行过程中切换注意力并行布局的服务系统。它基于一个关键观察：现代注意力机制（具有少量或没有KV头）将请求KV缓存的存储位置与注意力权重的分片方式解耦。这带来两个结果：第一，不同布局的区别仅在于谁拥有权重和缓存，而这些状态的大部分……
tldr: SPLASH是一个能够在请求运行过程中无缝切换注意力并行布局（张量并行、数据并行、上下文并行）的大语言模型服务系统，它利用现代注意力机制中KV缓存位置与权重分片方式解耦的特性，使服务引擎能够随负载变化动态选择最优并行策略。
en_tdlr: SPLASH is an LLM serving system that seamlessly switches attention parallel layouts (tensor, data, or context parallelism) while requests are running, leveraging the decoupling between KV cache placement and weight sharding in modern attention to dynamically adapt the parallel strategy to changing workloads.
